Riley Moore: hey team! quick questions ahead of my start next Monday (Sydney-based). 1) My offer mentions a childcare reimbursement pilot 100 AUD/month capped for 6 months2; how do I submit receipts and will that appear as taxable income? 2) I got a superannuation contribution from my previous employer that overlaps my start; does Redwood coordinate rollovers or top-ups? 3) Monday is a public holiday in NSW where I live  will that change benefits effective date or my first paycheck date?

Hannah (People Ops): welcome Riley! :tada: Short answers: (1) Childcare pilot: submit itemized receipts (name of childcare provider, service dates, amount) to the employee portal under "Childcare Pilot". We reimburse via AP after Benefits approval. It is treated as a taxable allowance under AUS payroll, so it will be grossed on the payroll run and taxed accordingly. We also provide a monthly summary statement for your records.

Hannah (People Ops): (2) Super: Redwood uses the standard AU Super Choice process. We dont automatically roll over previous employer contributions. If you want us to pay to a new fund we need your fund details (USI or ABN), member number, and we can initiate ongoing contributions from your first payroll. For any prior fund transfers/rollovers youll need to use the Australian Tax Office process or the fund's rollover form; we can provide a letter of employment if the fund requests proof of employment dates.

Ben (Payroll): adding payroll notes: Childcare reimbursements submitted as the pilot are processed as earnings and taxed per PAYG. Timing: submit receipts by the payroll cutoff (Thursday 12:00 AEDT) to appear on that payrun. If you submit after cutoff it will be processed on the next run. For the public holiday  because your start date falls on a company-observed holiday in your region, benefits effective date remains your official start date in Workday. Pay date: payroll processing follows the schedule; if bank holidays delay bank settlement, your net pay may arrive a business day later.

Riley Moore: thanks. Follow-ups: a) do I need original paper receipts or are photos/PDFs fine? b) for super: I submitted my preferred fund in Workday but havent provided member number yet  can you confirm what exact fields are required? c) if the holiday delays the first direct deposit should I expect a physical pay stub via mail?

Hannah (People Ops): a) photos/PDFs are fine as long as they are legible and show provider name/date/amount. b) for Super we need Fund name, USI/ABN, membership number (or a statement that you are a new member if you applied but number pending). If youre switching from an international fund please DM me and Ill loop in Benefits for the correct forms. c) we dont mail physical stubs routinely. If a direct deposit fails due to holiday or bank mismatch we will notify you and either reissue a deposit on the next business day or arrange a manual EFT/cheque if necessary.

Benefits Bot: :memo: Checklist added to thread: upload childcare receipts to portal, confirm super fund details in Workday, verify bank details before payroll cutoff. See https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/x/AU-Onboard for region-specific docs.

Ben (Payroll): Riley  can you DM me your bank account BSB and account number and the payroll reference you used in Workday? Ill pre-validate before the cutoff. Also tell me if youre receiving any sign-on or relocation payments so we classify correctly for tax.

Riley Moore: DMd BSB/account and noted the relocation amount (yes, $4,000 AUD lump in offer). Uploaded a childcare receipt for April and added my super fund details (USI + "pending member number" comment). Thanks all!
